descriptionChirho: A fragrant ointment, perfumed oil, or unguent used for anointing the body, whether for cosmetic, medicinal, or devotional purposes. Central to the anointing narratives (Mk 14:3-5, Lk 7:37-38, Jn 12:3-5). All three clusters share the same referent across languages: eng 'ointment', spa 'perfume/ungüento', hin इत्र ('perfume/fragrance'), arb طيب ('perfume/fragrant substance'), kor 향유 ('fragrant oil'), swa 'marhamu/manukato/mafuta ya manukato' ('ointment/perfume/perfumed oil'). The splits are purely case-driven (GNS, ANS, NNS, ANP vs instrumental DNS 'with ointment' vs a second ANS) with no semantic differentiation in any target language.
